ISSUES
Critical:
- The "How It Works" page failed the web performance test. It is essential to investigate and resolve the issues causing this failure to ensure a smooth user experience.
insights: The "How It Works" page's failure suggests that there might be issues with the page's content, scripts, or images. An in-depth analysis of the page's components is required to identify and resolve the problems.
The homepage and pricing page load times could be improved by optimizing images, minifying CSS and JavaScript files, and leveraging browser caching.

The blog page's excellent performance can serve as a benchmark for optimizing the other pages. Analyzing the blog page's components and applying the best practices to other pages can help improve the overall web performance.
